summary: In Week 3 of the Crown Contest against the Lightning Fortress boss, Thunderbolt teams are highlighted for their exceptional damage output even without high inspiration levels. The video showcases three primary team compositions: Thunderbolt (5.71B+ damage), Dauntless (7.09B+ damage), and Toxin (6.70B+ damage). Thunderbolt teams outperform fully inspired Necrosis summoner teams due to strong elemental synergy and multi-hit mechanics. Recommended artifacts include Angelic Alliance, Golden Antlers, and Misty Conch alongside specific skill timing cycles.

teams.note: Thunderbolt team achieving 5.71B+ damage without high inspiration.
Dauntless team achieving 7.09B+ damage using an 18-second recast skill cycle.
Toxin team achieving 6.70B+ damage with high Enlightenment stacking.

meta_changes: Thunderbolt teams have risen in meta strength for Crown Contest boss fights, outperforming full Necrosis summoner teams even without high Inspiration.
tips: Ensure Perkunte holds the highest Attack stat in Thunderbolt teams to maximize overall damage scaling.
Use Golden Antlers on Nathaniel as a reliable substitute if Angelic Alliance is unavailable.
Set Dauntless skill timings to 18-second recast cycles to align ultimate damage buffs properly.
